subject: Invoice header normalization, split-payment routing & vendor registration for Aurora Retail
messages:
From: Aurora Procurement <procurement@auroraretail.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-portal@auroraretail.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor — PO split and invoice routing questions

Hi Grace,

We're ready to add Redwood as a vendor in Aurora's AP systems but have a couple of quirks on our side that I want to surface up front so we can avoid rework:

1) Aurora uses multi-entity remittance for several product lines — a single PO may need to be split across two legal entities (Aurora Retail US LLC and Aurora Logistics Inc). We need to confirm how Redwood will present invoice headers and whether you can produce separate invoice files for split-payment POs.

2) We require a VAT/tax identifier mapping for each invoice line for EU shipments (we're onboarding EU subsidiaries later this quarter). Does Redwood include VAT IDs per invoice-line or only at invoice header?

3) Our AP portal requires vendor registration + a signed bank mandate before the first payment. We will send you a portal invitation (vendor-portal@auroraretail.com) but wanted to confirm what documents you typically provide so our team can approve quickly.

Please share: a) the AP onboarding packet you prefer vendors to use, b) the CSV/PO header layout you need for split payments, and c) any timing constraints for processing the first payment after registration (we try to process the first live pay within 7 business days after bank mandate is approved).

Thanks — Linda Hansen (procurement lead)
Aurora Retail

[attachment: none]

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: procurement@auroraretail.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — PO split and invoice routing questions

Hi Linda / Aurora team,

Thanks for the heads up — happy to walk through this. High level answers up front, followed by an action checklist so we can get you live without friction.

Quick answers:
- We can emit invoice-level VAT IDs on invoice header and, when needed, include tax identifiers at the line level as a supplemental CSV for your AP ingestion.
- For split-POs that require payment to multiple Aurora entities, we can produce either: (A) a single PDF invoice with clearly marked "Remit-to" sections and a machine-readable companion CSV that maps PO-line -> remit entity; or (B) separate invoice files per remit entity (if you prefer separate documents for reconciliation).
- We need the signed bank mandate and the vendor registration completed in your portal before first payment. Once we have the completed mandate and your acceptance of a test PO, our finance team (cc'd) aims to be first-payment ready within 5–8 business days.

Action checklist (what we'll send this afternoon):
1) Redwood AP onboarding packet (standard) — includes vendor tax questionnaire and preferred invoice template.
2) PO header mapping CSV (example): columns we populate for split routing and tax-id per line.
3) Bank authorization form (PDF) for signature.
4) Instructions for returning a test PO acknowledgement — send back the filled Test_PO_2147.pdf.

Marissa (finance) — please see items 2 and 3 (I flagged where we need your quick confirmation on the bank mandate language for Aurora).

Linda — once you confirm which split approach Aurora prefers (single-invoice plus CSV vs separate invoice files), we'll prepare the files in that format and submit the registration packet to your portal.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
Redwood Inference

[attachment: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_Aurora_20261022.pdf; PO_Header_Mapping_Aurora.csv; Bank_Authorization_Form.pdf]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: procurement@auroraretail.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — PO split and invoice routing questions

Hi Linda / Grace,

Quick finance clarifications from Redwood's side:
- Invoice numbering: our system guarantees unique invoice numbers; for split-PO routing we can append a suffix (e.g., INV-20261022-2147-AUR1) so your reconciliation teams can reliably dedupe. Is that acceptable?
- E-invoicing / self-bill: we support self-bill exchanges but prefer Aurora to indicate which entity will ingest the supplier-originated invoice as the ERP source of truth.
- Remittance advice: we can deliver an SFTP manifest or push an EDIFACT/CSV depending on your ingestion. Please advise which of these two Aurora's portal supports.
- Early payment terms: Redwood offers a 1.5% early-pay discount if payment is received within 10 calendar days and the invoice is not older than 30 days. If Aurora runs early-pay through a 3rd-party program, confirm whether discount is applied at payment execution or enabled on the invoice level.

Next steps from Redwood finance (what we'll upload to your portal after Grace confirms preferred split approach):
1) Completed Bank Authorization Form (scanned PDF).
2) Completed vendor tax questionnaire (included in packet).
3) Sample invoices: one single-PDF-with-CSV mapping, and one separate-per-remit-entity PDF.

If you can share the portal's preferred file types for the PO-to-invoice mapping (CSV column order) and whether the portal can accept multiple invoices tied to the same PO number, we'll format accordingly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Financial Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

> On Thu, Oct 22, 2026 at 10:34 AM grace.oconnor@redwood.com wrote:
> > (see above)

From: Aurora Procurement <procurement@auroraretail.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vendor-portal@auroraretail.com, Linda Hansen <linda.hansen@auroraretail.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor — PO split and invoice routing questions

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Thanks for the detailed responses and the packet — we completed the vendor registration through the portal this morning and attached the filled mandate and vendor form for your records (Vendor_Registration_Form_Aurora_filled.pdf). We prefer option (A): single PDF invoice + companion CSV mapping PO lines to remit entities. That will keep our ERP ingestion simpler during the pilot.

Portal notes: the portal accepts CSV (comma) with the following required columns: PO_NUMBER, LINE_NUMBER, AMOUNT, VAT_ID, REMIT_ENTITY_CODE, INVOICE_REF. It will accept multiple invoices against the same PO provided each has a unique INVOICE_REF. We successfully uploaded the vendor form and bank mandate — you should see a vendor id assigned shortly.

Attached is Test_PO_2147.pdf — please ACK the test PO and upload the single-PDF invoice plus CSV mapping so we can run a dry reconciliation and approve the first live payment. Also confirming Aurora will aim for first live payment within 7 business days after bank mandate approval; appreciate the 5–8 business day target you noted.

One more tax note: for the EU subsidiary workstream we'll require a per-line VAT_ID present in the CSV (even if repeated at header).

Thanks,
Linda Hansen
Procurement Lead, Aurora Retail
procurement@auroraretail.com
